s0301.literal: " The Emperor accepted his words; all construction and repair projects were halted.

s0302.literal: On xinhai day princes including Buliyadun falsely accused Babusha of illegal acts; an edict banished Buliyadun and Tugan to Henan, Yinuhuan to Yangzhou, Nali to Huguang, Tainai to Jiangxi, and Banchu'wnai to Yunnan.

s0303.idiomatic: On renzi day 5,753 shi of grain were granted in relief to the Qipchaq Guard.

s0304.literal: On jiayin day the moon transgressed Ghost.
s0304.idiomatic: On jiayin day the moon transgressed Ghost.

s0307.idiomatic: On jiazi day an edict directed that 10 capital grain markets be added, selling 800 shi daily at fair price to relieve impoverished commoners.

s0308.idiomatic: On bingyin day director of the Palace Domestic Service Bureau Luoyuan was promoted to grand steward; 7,060 shi of grain were granted in relief to various armies.

s0309.idiomatic: Twelfth month, on xinwei day, Jingzheng Supervisory Office posts were increased to 8.

s0310.idiomatic: The Imperial Herd Office was established, rank fifth grade; it managed sheep for the Imperial Kitchen.

s0311.literal: On guiyou day Anpu, commissioner of the Xuanzheng and Huifu courts, was enfeoffed Duke of Qin State.
s0311.idiomatic: On guiyou day Anpu, commissioner of the Xuanzheng and Huifu courts, was enfeoffed Duke of Qin State.

s0312.literal: The Ministry of War vice minister and director posts were each increased by one.
s0312.idiomatic: The Ministry of War vice minister and director posts were each increased by one.

s0313.literal: On gengchen day Venus crossed the sky.
s0313.idiomatic: On gengchen day Venus crossed the sky.

s0314.idiomatic: 3,000 Shaanxi garrison-farm troops were again placed under the Hongcheng wanhu command.

s0315.literal: On renwu day an edict said: "This year's harvest failed — how can the people bear it?
s0315.idiomatic: On renwu day an edict said, "This year's harvest failed — how can the people bear it?

s0316.literal: Let the spring hunt not require provisioning support.
s0316.idiomatic: Let the spring hunt not require provisioning support.

s0317.literal: " On guimao day Venus crossed the sky.
s0317.idiomatic: On guimao day Venus crossed the sky.

s0318.literal: On jiashen day the moon transgressed the Western Rampart Upper General of the Supreme Palace Enclosure.
s0318.idiomatic: On jiashen day the moon transgressed the Western Rampart Upper General of the Supreme Palace Enclosure.

s0319.literal: Western Zhejiang suffered flooding; one-quarter of Jiang-Zhe grain transport tribute was remitted, and retained grain was used for relief;
s0319.idiomatic: Western Zhejiang suffered flooding; one-quarter of Jiang-Zhe grain transport tribute was remitted, and retained grain was used for relief;

s0320.literal: Jiangxi and Huguang were ordered to make up transport and deliver to the capital.
s0320.idiomatic: Jiangxi and Huguang were ordered to make up transport and deliver to the capital.

s0321.idiomatic: Champa dispatched envoys presenting a memorial and tribute goods.

s0322.literal: On gengyin day the prohibition on Han Chinese carrying bows, arrows, weapons, and hunting was reiterated.
s0322.idiomatic: On gengyin day the prohibition on Han Chinese carrying bows, arrows, weapons, and hunting was reiterated.

s0323.literal: A partial amnesty was granted in the Central Capital for one prisoner facing capital punishment, and for crimes below exile.
s0323.idiomatic: A partial amnesty was granted in the Central Capital for one prisoner facing capital punishment, and for crimes below exile.

s0324.idiomatic: On xinmao day Imperial Clan Court posts were reduced to 28; officials were dispatched to supervise burning Zhida notes.

s0325.literal: On renchen day Venus crossed the sky.
s0325.idiomatic: On renchen day Venus crossed the sky.

s0326.literal: An edict stated: "For newly established frontier officials, credentials shall be issued only upon arrival at post."
s0326.idiomatic: An edict stated, "For newly established frontier officials, credentials shall be issued only upon arrival at post."

s0327.idiomatic: On yiwei day Li Meng was ordered to put the Directorate of Education in order.

s0328.idiomatic: Central secretariat officials said, "Shizu established promotion and demotion in the selection law to show encouragement and admonition.

s0329.idiomatic: Now officials have not yet reached evaluation, or are replaced without cause, or advance by skipping grades, usurping titles such as state duke and chancellor — offices already cut are re-established.

s0330.literal: This spring alone, more than one thousand persons were appointed by inner-palace edict; among them, how can all fraud be known?
s0330.idiomatic: This spring alone, more than 1,000 persons were appointed by inner-palace edict; among them, how can all fraud be known?

s0331.literal: Nothing damages and disrupts the selection law more than this.
s0331.idiomatic: Nothing damages and disrupts the selection law more than this.

s0332.literal: " The Emperor said: "All inner-palace edicts — let none be carried out.

s0333.literal: " A seal was granted to Prince of Ji Dilegenei; Yanqing Temple was built with Karakorum tax revenues.
s0333.idiomatic: A seal was granted to Prince of Ji Dilegenei; Yanqing Temple was built with Karakorum tax revenues.

s0334.literal: An edict addressed Crown Prince Chen Rikui of Annan, saying: "Our ancestors received Heaven's bright mandate, holding all within the four seas; where authority and virtue reach, the distant are softened and the near are brought close.
s0334.idiomatic: An edict addressed Crown Prince Chen Rikui of Annan, saying, "Our ancestors received Heaven's bright mandate, holding all within the four seas; where authority and virtue reach, the distant are softened and the near are brought close.

s0335.literal: Recently the Late Emperor ascended as a guest upon the dragon chariot; because kings, nobles, officials, and people could not set aside their grief, on the eighteenth day of the third month of the fourth year of Zhida We ascended the throne, following the institution of changing the era name after a full year — making the fifth year of Zhida the first year of Huangqing.
s0335.idiomatic: Recently the Late Emperor ascended as a guest upon the dragon chariot; because kings, nobles, officials, and people could not set aside their grief, on the 18th day of the third month of the fourth year of Zhida We ascended the throne, following the institution of changing the era name after a full year — making the fifth year of Zhida the first year of Huangqing.

s0336.literal: We now dispatch Minister of Rites Namaimatai and others bearing the edict to instruct you, and also issue one copy of the Huangqing first-year calendar.
s0336.idiomatic: We now dispatch Minister of Rites Namaimatai and others bearing the edict to instruct you, and also issue one copy of the Huangqing first-year calendar.

s0337.literal: See that you reverently grant the seasons to the people, further cultivate your ministerial duties, do not fall short of your ancestors' sincerity in serving the Great, and fulfill Our intent never to forget soothing the distant."
s0337.idiomatic: See that you reverently grant the seasons to the people, further cultivate your ministerial duties, do not fall short of your ancestors' sincerity in serving the Great, and fulfill Our intent never to forget soothing the distant."

s0338.literal: First year of Huangqing, spring, first month, on gengzi day the Emperor instructed Censor-in-Chief Tasibuhua, saying: "Whenever grand ministers act unlawfully, you shall memorialize and impeach without evasion; We shall judge it Ourselves.
s0338.idiomatic: First year of Huangqing, spring, first month, on gengzi day the Emperor instructed Censor-in-Chief Tasibuhua, saying, "Whenever grand ministers act unlawfully, you shall memorialize and impeach without evasion; We shall judge it Ourselves.

s0339.literal: " On guimao day an edict directed that monks guilty of adultery, theft, fraud, or litigation still be handled exclusively by the regular authorities.
s0339.idiomatic: On guimao day an edict directed that monks guilty of adultery, theft, fraud, or litigation still be handled exclusively by the regular authorities.

s0343.idiomatic: On renzi day an edict directed that armies numbering fewer than 5,000 should not have wanhu posts established.

s0344.literal: On guichou day the moon transgressed the Eastern Rampart Upper General of the Supreme Palace Enclosure.
s0344.idiomatic: On guichou day the moon transgressed the Eastern Rampart Upper General of the Supreme Palace Enclosure.

s0348.literal: On jiwei day Chongxiang Superintendency was raised to Chongxiang Court, rank upper second grade.
s0348.idiomatic: On jiwei day Chongxiang Superintendency was raised to Chongxiang Court, rank upper second grade.

s0349.literal: On renxu day Hanlin and National History Academy rank was raised to secondary first grade.
s0349.idiomatic: On renxu day Hanlin and National History Academy rank was raised to secondary first grade.

s0350.idiomatic: The Emperor instructed provincial officials, saying, "Hanlin and Academicians Exemplar Confucian officials — We select them Ourselves; you shall not presumptuously propose appointments.
